inputs.command: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== ENV NAMES ==='; (env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -Ei 'CLOUDFLARE|CF_|ZERO|ACCESS' | sort -u) || true; echo '=== MADWORLD ENV NAMES ==='; for f in /opt/madworld/.env /opt/madworld/.env.*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "$f"; grep -E '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' "$f" | sed 's/=.*$/=REDACTED/' | grep -Ei 'CLOUDFLARE|CF_|ZERO|ACCESS' || true; }; done; echo '=== CLOUDFLARED ==='; command -v cloudflared || true; systemctl is-active cloudflared 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== ACCESS CONFIG FILES ==='; find /etc /opt/madworld -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*cloudflare*' -o -iname '*cloudflared*' -o -iname '*access*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100
